programme.purpose: Everyday meals, guests, studio sessions, dinners and parties.
programme.cordialProgramme: Crispin Vale specified the cordial programme and its intended flavour, fruit/acidity/sweetness balance and service character. The kitchen makes it to his specifications. Rafael Bellocq retains kitchen production methods, food safety and batch release; Élodie coordinates quantities and Bethan and the team make the batches. Crispin checks the finished drinks against his specifications and agrees service selection with Harjit.
programme.drinksService: Albury house water, soda water, mixers and bottled soft drinks are Limestone Springs. The wine and spirits selection spans many producers and includes the full commercial Hatfield spirits and wine lines, subject to confirmed cellar stock. Crispin and Harjit coordinate service; the private Alex family barrel is not a bar listing.

availableFood.title: After a run, swim or gym
availableFood.description: Scrambled eggs on sourdough, yoghurt with seasonal fruit and toasted oat, almond and seed granola, or chicken and rice if you’re properly hungry.
availableFood.veganOption: Porridge made with oat milk, fruit and toasted seeds.

availableFood.title: A quick warm plate
availableFood.description: A bowl of soup with sourdough, a mushroom and Comté toastie with dressed leaves, or an omelette and toast.
availableFood.veganOption: Tomato and basil soup with sourdough when the kitchen has a batch ready.

availableFood.title: A break in the studio
availableFood.description: Chicken club sandwiches, chicken-and-rice bowls or a substantial salad for the session.
availableFood.veganOption: Roast pepper and white bean sandwiches on olive-oil sourdough.
availableFood.serviceNote: Give the kitchen a head count and a break time. Food goes to the rec room.

availableFood.title: When friends drop in
availableFood.description: For a few people, cut chicken clubs into quarters or set out Parmesan and black-pepper sablés, rosemary and smoked-salt almonds and house pickles. If it turns into supper, ask the kitchen what it can put out to share.
availableFood.veganOption: White bean dip, radishes, cucumber and seeded rye crackers.

availableFood.title: Coming home late
availableFood.description: Soup and bread, a cheese toastie or a prepared bowl of chicken and rice.
availableFood.veganOption: A baked potato with herbed white beans, arranged ahead.
availableFood.serviceNote: Tell the team when you expect to be back. The duty team can leave something ready if the kitchen will have finished service.

availableFood.title: Something for the journey
availableFood.description: A morning pastry, fruit and a drink for an early start. For a longer journey, ask for a packed sandwich or a substantial salad.
availableFood.veganOption: White bean and roast vegetable salad, with fruit alongside.
availableFood.serviceNote: Give the team a departure time and any dietary requirements.
